findings.title: A previous booth history replaces the selected booth history
findings.flow: Hold A version refresh, select B, observe B history, release A.
findings.observed: B history disappears after the old A result. Same actor/operator/park throughout; global authority protection does not cover booth selection.
findings.proposedCorrectionForApproval: Bind all booth/list/detail reads and post-write refreshes to a monotonic selected-target/request generation, retaining independent read errors. Preserve API authority and native presentation.

findings.title: Old park equipment remains under a newly selected park
findings.flow: Read park A fleet, select B while B read is held.
findings.observed: The command bar selects Robinson Chalong while original Central fleet and station controls remain present. No equipment action was dispatched.
findings.proposedCorrectionForApproval: Clear or context-tag retained fleet rows immediately on park change and reject old park completions. Bind drawers/actions to their captured targets; do not change grants or fleet rules.

findings.title: Failed equipment reads make false empty-register claims
findings.flow: Refuse the first box read and, separately, the first station read with500.
findings.observed: A real error banner coexists with “No box at this branch yet” / “No stations yet” and add-first guidance. Existing count-suppression controls do pass.
findings.proposedCorrectionForApproval: Keep per-list unread/failed/stale/empty states. Draw empty-register advice only after that list answers successfully, retaining other independently successful lists.

findings.title: Missing record404 is presented as an undeployed API
findings.flow: Return the native404 BOOTH_NOT_FOUND / “No booth with that id” for a selected draft.
findings.observed: The native reason disappears; the page says its draft route is not deployed and cites SCRUM-200.
findings.proposedCorrectionForApproval: Distinguish a genuine missing-route fallback from structured resource404, preserving the server reason and an appropriate reread. Check other isMissingRoute consumers without broad policy changes.

findings.title: A shrinking ledger produces an inverted range and misleading empty text
findings.flow: Read50of51, request offset50, then receive valid total1/rows[].
findings.observed: The footer says “51–50 of1”; the page also says nothing matches although one record exists on an earlier page.
findings.proposedCorrectionForApproval: Use an honest empty-current-page state and navigable previous page or reset the stale offset. Bookings.tsx263 has the same range expression by static inspection; money-domain reconciliation is outside this UI audit.

sourceCandidates.next: Hold export, change filters, release; assert no obsolete download/note, then propose a current owner/ref guard.

sourceCandidates.title: A late maintenance completion may close a replacement app drawer

messageIssues.title: Permission advice directs staff to removed Login Users panel
messageIssues.exact: A manager can grant it from the Login Users panel.
messageIssues.recommendation: Point to current People & access → Accounts / Roles & scopes. Keep permission codes as secondary diagnostic information.

messageIssues.title: Direct platform-only refusal does not explain the missing scope
messageIssues.reason: Section can refuse a non-platform account that already holds the named permission, then displays only that permission as what is needed.
messageIssues.recommendation: Explain the required platform-wide authority and current context, rather than imply the same held permission is absent. No permission change.

messageIssues.title: Generic unread/error text sometimes describes the wrong thing
exact: That is a request that did not answer, not a fact about this box
messageIssues.reason: A403/404 is an answered refusal; shared Unreadable is used for non-box data too. Ticket numbers and old release explanations do not tell park staff what to do.
messageIssues.recommendation: Keep resource, cause, unchanged-state/uncertainty and next action explicit; retain technical code/request detail behind optional disclosure. Never replace an actual reason with a generic all-clear.

messageIssues.title: Discount usage banner appears to describe an older implementation
messageIssues.exact: Usage counts are this tab only — SCRUM-230.
messageIssues.reason: Payment/API reviewer confirmed from source: usedCount counts distinct persisted finalised sale IDs for this operator/definition code since the definition was created. The generated response, mapper and Console panel retain it. It is cumulative across branches, not tab-local or the selected report range. This is a source-only wording finding; no new native counter test was run.
messageIssues.recommendation: Propose wording that describes this persisted cumulative usage basis, retaining genuinely local manual-discount reasons and the differently windowed usage/value report labels.

filterProposals.classification: USABILITY / missing filter capability, not isolation failure
filterProposals.existing: Action, actor, branch, outcome, request id, entity, From/To, app, target app; Data access and Denials server filters.
filterProposals.limitation: Admin log, Staff log and Sign-in log explicitly leave the list unfiltered and show a warning. Request id narrows only the returned page.
filterProposals.proposal: Either clearly mark unsupported presets unavailable, or approve actual server category/request filtering. Label bounded Related results honestly. Keep the current explicit warnings until real filtering exists.
filterProposals.userReason: A support person must know whether an empty result means no event or an incomplete search.

filterProposals.classification: Validation proposal / API reviewer owns reversed-range reproduction
filterProposals.existing: Native From/To inputs drive immediate reads; Activity DateTimeFilter has no paired bound.
filterProposals.proposal: Validate From≤To at the filter boundary, name the bad field, retain the previous selection and avoid a misleading no-match claim.
filterProposals.userReason: An invalid period should not look like a day with no business or audit events.

filterProposals.proposal: Offer explicit filters for unavailable reads, actionable failures, agent below minimum/unknown version, expired/near-expiry metadata and active versus historical rows, reusing native status categories.
filterProposals.userReason: Find the items needing attention without scanning all healthy/history rows. Do not introduce new thresholds or redefine healthy.

filterProposals.proposal: Add search/sort only to genuinely long lists, show current result count and distinguish current-page empty from globally empty. Prefer names over raw IDs, retain stable ordering, and make clear/reset behavior consistent.
filterProposals.userReason: The navigation has20 Catalogue entries and several full-list read surfaces; staff need to find a person/item/setting quickly without changing authority.

filterProposals.proposal: Audit a keyboard focus trap/return focus in the custom Drawer; announce dynamic errors consistently; associate field errors through described-by rather than changing accessible labels; show clear pending/confirmed/uncertain outcomes and why an action is disabled.
filterProposals.userReason: A keyboard/phone user must understand and recover from a refusal without losing a draft. This proposal does not authorize a layout or business-rule redesign.
